name: aas_benchmark-sd3_alchemist
description: A prompt→image benchmark associated with the 'sd3_alchemist' variant intended to evaluate text-to-image generation quality and adherence to prompts. It contains example prompts and generated images (and optionally references or human ratings) to assess model fidelity, style transfer, and safety-related outputs. Designed for evaluating Stable Diffusion 3-style models and similar text-to-image systems.
reputation: Community / dataset appears to be a niche Hugging Face collection used for model-specific prompt evaluation with limited broad adoption.
